label: how much does it matter?
instructions: How much will it matter for {name} to remember line {n} of quoted_lines in future conversations with quoted_user?
levels: Not at all: small talk, or true only in the moment.
Somewhat: worth recalling now and then.
A lot: worth keeping in mind in later talks.
Central: it is central to who they are, or to what they share.
state_note: memory D14: one request per character per piece, keyed importance:l{n}; importance = unit (W11). Level 4 says 'worth keeping in mind' rather than naming the character, because the loader fills {name} in the instructions only. M14 adds instruction:l{n} beside it through extra_questions, so this entry is never re-versioned for it (D38).
